entries.en: The two rope samples used Seale construction, although their diameters were different.
entries.zh: 那两根钢丝绳样品都采用西鲁结构，不过直径不同。

entries.en: Poulton kept the cracked cup because it reminded him of his first flat.
entries.zh: 波尔顿留着那个裂了的杯子，因为它让他想起自己的第一套公寓。

entries.en: Partington listened to the recording twice before admitting that the voice was his.
entries.zh: 帕廷顿听了两遍录音，才承认那是自己的声音。

entries.en: We reached Pamplona with enough time to find our hotel before dinner.
entries.zh: 我们到达潘普洛纳时，离晚饭还有足够的时间找到酒店。

entries.en: Miroslav could carry the box alone, but he needed help opening the door.
entries.zh: 米罗斯拉夫一个人搬得动那个箱子，但需要有人帮他开门。

entries.en: McAvoy returned from the kitchen carrying a plate with only one biscuit on it.
entries.zh: 麦卡沃伊从厨房回来，端着一个只放了一块饼干的盘子。

entries.en: Mannion's apology sounded sincere until he began explaining why everyone else was also to blame.
entries.zh: 曼尼恩的道歉听起来很真诚，直到他开始解释为什么其他人也都有责任。

entries.meaningZh: 利马索尔〔塞浦路斯地名〕
entries.en: Our last evening in Limassol was spent searching for a lost pair of glasses.
entries.zh: 我们在利马索尔的最后一个晚上是在寻找一副丢失的眼镜中度过的。

entries.en: We collected the forgotten suitcase from Islip before continuing our journey.
entries.zh: 我们到艾斯利普取回了遗忘的行李箱，然后继续赶路。

entries.en: Eusebio knew the tune but could not remember where he had first heard it.
entries.zh: 欧塞维奥熟悉那个曲调，却想不起自己最初是在哪里听到的。

entries.en: Eastham held the ladder steady while I retrieved the kite from the branch.
entries.zh: 我从树枝上取风筝时，伊斯特汉扶稳了梯子。

entries.en: Colson was halfway through reading the letter when the lights went out.
entries.zh: 科尔森的信读到一半，灯就灭了。

entries.en: Cockerill had brought the right key, but the lock had been changed.
entries.zh: 科克里尔带对了钥匙，但锁已经换过了。

entries.en: Cawley offered to mend the chair in exchange for a lesson on the piano.
entries.zh: 考利提出修好那把椅子，换取一节钢琴课。

entries.en: The actor playing Banquo asked to repeat the scene without the background music.
entries.zh: 扮演班柯的演员要求去掉背景音乐，再演一遍那场戏。

entries.en: He brought two cans of Asahi to the picnic but left them unopened.
entries.zh: 他带了两罐朝日啤酒去野餐，却没有打开。

entries.en: Turton noticed the uneven hem only after putting on the coat.
entries.zh: 特顿穿上外套后，才注意到下摆不齐。

entries.en: Shand refused the front seat so that the child could see the mountains.
entries.zh: 尚德不肯坐前排座位，好让那个孩子能看见群山。

entries.en: Prestwich expected a difficult conversation, not an invitation to stay for lunch.
entries.zh: 普雷斯特维奇原以为要进行一场棘手的谈话，没想到等来的却是留下吃午饭的邀请。

entries.en: Pendleton kept moving the lamp until the shadow no longer crossed his drawing.
entries.zh: 彭德尔顿不断挪动灯，直到阴影不再横过他的画。

entries.en: Northcote found a small wooden boat inside the parcel his father had sent.
entries.zh: 诺思科特在父亲寄来的包裹里发现了一只小木船。

entries.en: Mrs Landseer taught us to listen for the quietest instrument in the orchestra.
entries.zh: 兰西尔夫人教我们留意管弦乐队里声音最轻的那件乐器。

entries.en: Kremer had saved the newspaper, though he could no longer explain why.
entries.zh: 克雷默一直留着那份报纸，尽管他已说不清原因。

entries.en: Kearney recognised the handwriting on the envelope before looking at the address.
entries.zh: 卡尼还没看地址，就认出了信封上的笔迹。

entries.en: Honorius left a note asking us not to wake the dog.
entries.zh: 奥诺里于斯留了一张纸条，请我们别把狗吵醒。

entries.en: Gott thought the room was empty until someone coughed behind the curtain.
entries.zh: 戈特原以为房间里没人，直到窗帘后有人咳嗽了一声。

entries.en: Cyrano tried to hide his disappointment when the parcel turned out to contain socks.
entries.zh: 发现包裹里原来是袜子时，西拉诺努力掩饰自己的失望。

entries.en: Cranley turned the map upside down and suddenly understood where we had gone wrong.
entries.zh: 克兰利把地图倒过来，突然明白我们是在哪里走错了。

entries.en: Cracknell promised to bring the missing page to our next meeting.
entries.zh: 克拉克内尔答应下次见面时带来缺失的那一页。

entries.meaningZh: 科里奥兰纳斯〔莎士比亚剧中人物〕
entries.en: Our rehearsal stopped because the actor playing Coriolanus had lost his voice.
entries.zh: 我们的排练停了下来，因为扮演科里奥兰纳斯的演员嗓子哑了。

entries.en: Bentinck opened the gate just wide enough for the bicycle to pass through.
entries.zh: 本廷克把大门打开到刚好能让自行车通过的程度。

entries.meaningZh: 芬尼亚会会员〔历史用语〕
entries.en: The historical novel follows a Fenian who argues bitterly with his father about the movement.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说描写了一名因运动问题而与父亲激烈争论的芬尼亚会会员。

entries.en: She prefers Scofield to the other characters in the series.
entries.zh: 在那部电视剧的角色中，相比其他人，她更喜欢斯科菲尔德。

entries.en: Rother borrowed my camera and returned it with a new photograph of his cat on its memory card.
entries.zh: 罗瑟借了我的相机，还回来时存储卡里多了一张他家猫的照片。

entries.en: Rickard wanted the room with the balcony, even though it faced the car park.
entries.zh: 里卡德想要带阳台的那间房，尽管它朝着停车场。

entries.en: Redcliffe folded the sheet of paper carefully, trying not to crease the painted corner.
entries.zh: 雷德克利夫小心地把那张纸折起来，尽量不折到画了颜色的那个角。

entries.en: Pryce remembered the meal mainly because the conversation had been so awkward.
entries.zh: 普赖斯之所以记得那顿饭，主要是因为当时的谈话太尴尬了。

entries.en: Jamal waited until the last guest had left before asking about the broken vase.
entries.zh: 贾马尔等到最后一位客人离开，才问起打碎的花瓶。

entries.en: Grimley drew a second doorway on the plan to show us his alternative idea.
entries.zh: 格里姆利在平面图上又画了一个门口，向我们说明他的另一种设想。

entries.en: Frantz laughed when he discovered that both tickets were for yesterday's performance.
entries.zh: 发现两张票都是昨天那场演出的票时，弗朗茨笑了。

entries.en: Battista wrapped the bowl in a towel before placing it in the box.
entries.zh: 巴蒂斯塔先用毛巾包住碗，再把它放进箱子。

entries.meaningZh: 大卫或其后裔的〔《圣经》语境〕
entries.en: Two students disputed the Davidic ancestry attributed to the king in the story.
entries.zh: 两名学生质疑故事中赋予那位国王的大卫血统。

entries.en: The production's Chekhovian atmosphere depended on pauses rather than dramatic confrontations.
entries.zh: 那出戏的契可夫式氛围依靠的是停顿，而不是激烈的冲突。

entries.en: Wortley put the receipt in his wallet and immediately forgot which pocket he had used.
entries.zh: 沃特利把收据放进钱包，随即就忘了放在哪个夹层里。

entries.en: Winthrop could hear the sea from the window but could not see it.
entries.zh: 温思罗普从窗口能听见海声，却看不到海。

entries.en: Rifat chose the smallest desk because it would fit beside the window.
entries.zh: 里法特选了最小的那张书桌，因为它能放在窗边。

entries.en: She found her Revlon lipstick in the coat she had lent me.
entries.zh: 她在借给我的那件外套里找到了自己的露华浓口红。

entries.en: The suitcase reached Pavia a day after its owner did.
entries.zh: 那个行李箱比主人晚一天到达帕维亚。

entries.en: We left our wet umbrellas at the Novotel reception desk while looking for the booking confirmation.
entries.zh: 我们找预订确认信息时，把湿雨伞放在了诺富特酒店的接待台。

entries.en: Millward painted over the doorway twice before finding a colour he liked.
entries.zh: 米尔沃德把门口重新刷了两遍，才找到自己喜欢的颜色。

entries.en: Michie was annoyed by the noise but reluctant to interrupt the children's game.
entries.zh: 米基被吵得心烦，却不愿打断孩子们的游戏。

entries.en: The keys to her Daihatsu were in the basket beneath the newspapers.
entries.zh: 她那辆大发汽车的钥匙在报纸下面的篮子里。

entries.en: Crosbie ate slowly, hoping the rain would stop before he had to leave.
entries.zh: 克罗斯比慢慢地吃着，希望在自己必须离开前雨能停下来。

entries.en: Cockerell wanted to keep the scratched table rather than replace it with a smaller one.
entries.zh: 科克雷尔想留着那张有划痕的桌子，而不是换一张小一些的。

entries.en: Christoph practised the difficult passage until his fingers began to ache.
entries.zh: 克里斯托夫反复练习那个困难的乐段，直到手指开始酸痛。

entries.en: Cathcart pulled up a chair, apparently expecting the discussion to last all afternoon.
entries.zh: 卡思卡特拉过一把椅子，显然以为这场讨论要持续整个下午。

entries.en: The traveller in the historical novel mistakes a Mede for his missing guide.
entries.zh: 那部历史小说里的旅行者把一名米堤亚人误认成自己失踪的向导。

entries.en: Townley returned the photograph without asking who the woman beside me was.
entries.zh: 汤利归还了照片，没有问我身旁的那个女人是谁。

entries.en: Shawcross insisted on washing the dishes, although he was supposed to be our guest.
entries.zh: 肖克罗斯坚持要洗碗，尽管他本该是我们的客人。

entries.en: Raeburn asked for a quieter room after hearing the traffic outside his window.
entries.zh: 听到窗外的车流声后，雷伯恩要求换一间安静些的房间。

entries.en: Dr Kiefer postponed the discussion until everyone had read the revised proposal.
entries.zh: 基弗博士把讨论推迟到所有人都读过修改后的提案之后。

entries.en: Holbrook found the missing screw inside the pocket of his work jacket.
entries.zh: 霍尔布鲁克在工作夹克的口袋里找到了丢失的螺丝。

entries.en: Hilliard could not understand why the cake had a photograph of a tractor on it.
entries.zh: 希利亚德不明白蛋糕上为什么会有一张拖拉机的照片。

entries.en: Goodchild had already packed the books when we decided to keep the bookcase.
entries.zh: 我们决定留下书柜时，古德柴尔德已经把书打包好了。

entries.en: Gonzalo made room on the bench for the woman carrying a sleeping child.
entries.zh: 贡柴罗在长椅上挪出位置，留给那位抱着熟睡孩子的女人。

entries.en: Miss Forsythe lent me a pencil and asked me to draw what I could hear.
entries.zh: 福赛思小姐借给我一支铅笔，让我把听到的东西画出来。

entries.en: Cowen struggled to stay awake through the film but wanted to know how it ended.
entries.zh: 考恩看电影时困得很，却又想知道结局。

entries.en: Bowley put the broken pieces in a box instead of throwing them away.
entries.zh: 鲍利把碎片放进了一个盒子，没有扔掉。

entries.en: Mrs Malan let us use her kitchen while ours was being repaired.
entries.zh: 我们家的厨房维修期间，马伦夫人让我们使用她家的厨房。

entries.en: Kellner remembered bringing the umbrella but not where he had left it.
entries.zh: 凯尔纳记得带来了雨伞，却不记得放在哪里了。

entries.en: Crosfield stayed behind to help a student who had missed the demonstration.
entries.zh: 克罗斯菲尔德留了下来，帮助一名错过演示的学生。

entries.en: Colville waited by the stairs with a bunch of flowers wrapped in damp paper.
entries.zh: 科尔维尔拿着一束用湿纸包着的花，在楼梯旁等候。

entries.en: Clicquot laughed at the drawing, then asked if she could keep it.
entries.zh: 克利科看着那幅画笑了，随后问她能否留下它。

entries.en: Caversham cleared the table so that we could spread out the damaged map.
entries.zh: 卡弗沙姆收拾了桌子，让我们能够摊开那张破损的地图。

entries.en: Berri reached into his bag and produced a surprisingly large bunch of keys.
entries.zh: 贝里把手伸进包里，掏出了一串钥匙，数量多得让人吃惊。

entries.en: Asaph had been saving the last orange for someone who never arrived.
entries.zh: 阿萨夫一直把最后一个橙子留给某个人，但那个人始终没来。

entries.meaningZh: 社会科学统计套装软件〔SPSS〕
entries.en: She reopened SPSS after discovering that the data file was still on her old laptop.
entries.zh: 她发现数据文件还在旧笔记本电脑上后，重新打开了SPSS统计软件。

entries.en: Our discussion of Philo continued over lunch, despite my unfinished reading.
entries.zh: 虽然我还没读完材料，我们对斐洛的讨论还是一直延续到了午饭时。

entries.en: Mehdi wanted to take the long way home because the shorter path was so muddy.
entries.zh: 迈赫迪想绕远路回家，因为较近的那条路太泥泞了。

entries.en: Leonards put a cushion behind his back and settled down to read the letter.
entries.zh: 莱昂纳茨在背后垫了个靠垫，安顿好后开始读信。

entries.en: We arranged to meet at Leadenhall Market, but I waited at the wrong entrance.
entries.zh: 我们约好在Leadenhall市场见面，我却等在了错误的入口。

entries.en: Mr Langan carried the sleeping puppy upstairs without turning on the light.
entries.zh: 兰根先生没有开灯，抱着熟睡的小狗上了楼。

entries.en: Hawley had no objection to the colour, only to the size of the lettering.
entries.zh: 霍利对颜色没有意见，只对字的大小有意见。

entries.en: Harmer left the final decision to the children, who immediately began to disagree.
entries.zh: 哈默把最后的决定交给孩子们，他们立刻就争了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 博普塔茨瓦纳〔南非旧地名〕
entries.en: The family album includes several photographs taken in Bophuthatswana.
entries.zh: 那本家庭相册里有几张在博普塔茨瓦纳拍的照片。

entries.en: Adolphus brought a folding chair because he did not expect to find a seat.
entries.zh: 阿道弗斯带来一把折叠椅，因为他觉得会找不到座位。

entries.en: She sketched the Pictish stone while the rest of us waited in the car.
entries.zh: 我们其余人在车里等候时，她画了一幅那块皮克特石碑的速写。

entries.en: We left the Uffizi with tired feet and an argument about our favourite painting.
entries.zh: 我们离开乌菲齐美术馆时，双脚疲惫，还在争论最喜欢哪幅画。

entries.en: Studley had brought a spare shirt but forgotten the trousers he meant to wear with it.
entries.zh: 斯塔德利带了一件备用衬衫，却忘了本打算配着穿的那条裤子。

entries.en: Mulholland remembered every guest's name but forgot where he had put his own coat.
entries.zh: 马尔霍兰记得每位客人的名字，却忘了把自己的外套放在哪里了。

entries.en: Gilpin put off opening the parcel until his older sister could be there.
entries.zh: 吉尔平把拆包裹的事推迟了，想等姐姐能在场时再拆。

entries.en: Ghia pulled the blanket over his knees and asked us to continue the story.
entries.zh: 吉亚把毯子拉到膝盖上，请我们继续讲故事。

entries.en: Her research on Euonymus led her to visit a second herbarium to examine specimens.
entries.zh: 她对卫矛属的研究使她前往第二家植物标本馆查看标本。

entries.en: The workers cleared a space beside the baler for the next load of cardboard.
entries.zh: 工人在打包机旁腾出一片地方，准备放下一批纸板。

entries.en: Ranson was pleased with the photograph until he noticed the stranger in the background.
entries.zh: 兰森原本很满意那张照片，后来却发现背景里有个陌生人。

entries.en: Lockett stayed at the table to finish the jigsaw puzzle while we went for a walk.
entries.zh: 我们出去散步时，洛基特留在桌旁，想把那幅拼图拼完。

entries.en: Kelsey could not find the wrapping paper, so he used an old map instead.
entries.zh: 凯尔西找不到包装纸，就用一张旧地图代替。

entries.en: Mrs Hutt recognised the tune and began tapping her fingers on the table.
entries.zh: 赫特夫人听出了那个曲调，开始用手指在桌上打拍子。

entries.en: Danie held back a laugh when the magician asked for a completely ordinary hat.
entries.zh: 魔术师要求拿来一顶完全普通的帽子时，丹尼忍住了笑。

entries.en: Dilys had left a space in the garden for the bench her father was making.
entries.zh: 迪莉斯在花园里留出一处地方，准备放父亲正在做的长椅。

entries.en: Stonehaven let the telephone ring while he searched for a pen that worked.
entries.zh: 斯通黑文任由电话响着，自己寻找一支能写字的笔。

entries.en: Pritchett could see the station clock from the room where we were waiting.
entries.zh: 普里切特从我们等候的房间里能看到车站的钟。

entries.en: Kirton moved the empty cage away from the window before sweeping the floor.
entries.zh: 柯顿先把空笼子从窗边挪开，然后扫地。

entries.en: Gretel had chosen the photograph for its colours, not for the people in it.
entries.zh: 格蕾泰尔选那张照片是因为它的色彩，而不是里面的人。

entries.en: The gallery placed a Cycladic figurine beside a modern sculpture.
entries.zh: 美术馆把一尊基克拉迪文化的小雕像摆在一件现代雕塑旁。

entries.en: Her notebook contained a drawing of an Archimedean spiral beside a shopping list.
entries.zh: 她的笔记本上，购物清单旁画着一条阿基米德螺线。

entries.en: Her paternal grandfather's photographs of Biafra prompted questions that she had never thought to ask.
entries.zh: 祖父的那些比夫拉照片使她产生了一些以前从未想过要问的问题。

entries.en: A course in pharmacognosy changed the questions she asked about the museum's collection of dried plants.
entries.zh: 一门生药学课程改变了她针对博物馆干燥植物藏品所提的问题。

entries.en: Mr Oldman offered to take our photograph, then realised that he had left his glasses upstairs.
entries.zh: 奥德曼先生提出给我们拍照，随后却发现自己把眼镜忘在了楼上。

entries.en: The lecturer spent more time on Horatian poetry than on the poet's biography.
entries.zh: 讲师讲解贺瑞斯诗歌所用的时间，比介绍诗人生平所用的时间还多。

entries.en: Erikson put the kettle on, apparently assuming that the argument would continue.
entries.zh: 埃里克松烧上了水，显然认为争论还会继续。

entries.en: The Surinamese musicians asked for a few minutes to tune their instruments.
entries.zh: 那些苏里南音乐家请求留出几分钟，让他们给乐器调音。

entries.en: Comyn took a photograph of the arrangement before moving any of the furniture.
entries.zh: 科明在挪动任何家具之前，先拍了一张照片，记录原来的摆放情况。

entries.meaningZh: 赫居里士〔大力神法语名〕
entries.en: She borrowed a French-language picture book about Hercule from the children's library.
entries.zh: 她从儿童图书馆借了一本讲述大力神赫居里士的法语图画书。

entries.en: Girton thought the parcel was for him until he read the second line of the address.
entries.zh: 格顿原以为包裹是给自己的，直到他读到地址的第二行。

entries.en: Brien was still searching for his gloves when the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车到达时，布赖恩还在找手套。

entries.en: Kenyatta set aside the broken cup and reached for another one.
entries.zh: 肯雅塔把破杯子放到一旁，伸手去拿另一个。

entries.en: Dakin had memorised the opening sentence but lost his place as soon as he looked up.
entries.zh: 戴金背熟了开场的那句话，但一抬头就不知道该接着说哪儿了。

entries.en: The neurophysiologist asked whether the new graph included the earlier measurements.
entries.zh: 那位神经生理学家问新图表是否包含先前的测量数据。

entries.en: Our Calabrian host put an extra chair at the table before we arrived.
entries.zh: 那位接待我们的卡拉布里亚人在我们到达前，在桌旁添了一把椅子。

entries.en: Walkinshaw had promised a short visit but was still there when we began preparing dinner.
entries.zh: 沃金肖答应只待一会儿，但我们开始准备晚饭时，他还在那里。

entries.en: Schaefer noticed the smell of paint before seeing the freshly painted door.
entries.zh: 谢弗还没看到刚刷过的门，就先闻到了油漆味。

entries.en: Ecclestone put the heavy vase on the floor rather than trust it to another wobbly shelf.
entries.zh: 埃克尔斯通把沉重的花瓶放在地上，不愿再冒险放到另一块晃动的搁板上。

entries.en: Sandie had been looking forward to the concert but fell asleep before the final piece.
entries.zh: 桑迪原本很期待那场音乐会，却在最后一首曲子开始前睡着了。

entries.en: Garton stopped halfway through his explanation when he realised that no one was listening.
entries.zh: 加顿解释到一半，意识到没人听，便停了下来。

entries.en: Caswell brought a torch in case we had to cross the garden after dark.
entries.zh: 卡斯韦尔带了一支手电筒，以防我们需要在天黑后穿过花园。

entries.en: Candice had used the wrong colour, but she liked the result too much to change it.
entries.zh: 坎蒂丝用错了颜色，但她太喜欢这个效果，不愿再改。

entries.en: Urbino recognised the song from the first few notes and began searching for the record.
entries.zh: 乌尔比诺听了最初几个音就认出了那首歌，开始找那张唱片。

entries.en: Normanton left the last piece of cake for whoever returned first.
entries.zh: 诺曼顿把最后一块蛋糕留给最先回来的人。

entries.en: Lambton found the letter inside a book he had not opened for years.
entries.zh: 兰布顿在一本多年未翻开的书里发现了那封信。

entries.en: Grattan asked us to keep talking while he looked for the missing photograph.
entries.zh: 格拉顿让我们继续聊，自己去找那张不见了的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 夏尔丹〔指Pierre Teilhard de Chardin〕
entries.en: The seminar on Pierre Teilhard de Chardin was postponed because the speaker had lost her voice.
entries.zh: 那场关于夏尔丹的研讨会推迟了，因为主讲人嗓子哑了。

entries.en: Aird reached for the door handle, then remembered that he had come to apologise.
entries.zh: 艾尔德伸手去拉门把手，随后想起自己是来道歉的。

entries.en: A box of family photographs came with us when we moved from Stirlingshire.
entries.zh: 我们从斯特灵郡搬家时，也带上了一箱家庭照片。

entries.en: Popov pulled back the curtain and found the cat asleep on the window ledge.
entries.zh: 波波夫拉开窗帘，发现猫在窗台上睡着了。

entries.en: Maxton brought a small notebook but never took it out of his pocket.
entries.zh: 马克斯顿带了一本小笔记本，却始终没有从口袋里拿出来。

entries.en: Maurier had meant to stay for an hour, but the conversation lasted until midnight.
entries.zh: 莫里耶本来只打算待一个小时，谈话却一直持续到午夜。

entries.en: Jackman could see that the parcel was damaged without even opening it.
entries.zh: 杰克曼甚至不用拆开，就看得出包裹破损了。

entries.en: Jeanie moved her chair so that the child could sit beside the window.
entries.zh: 珍妮挪动了自己的椅子，让那个孩子能够坐在窗边。

entries.en: The visitor stopped talking when the bushmaster moved behind the log in its enclosure.
entries.zh: 那条巨蝮移到圈养区内的木头后面时，参观者停止了说话。

entries.en: Valera had forgotten the address but remembered the blue door and the broken step.
entries.zh: 瓦莱拉忘了地址，却记得蓝色的门和破损的台阶。

entries.en: Ms Amory asked me to keep the original drawing and send her a copy.
entries.zh: 艾默利女士让我保留原画，给她送去一份副本。

entries.en: Her project compared thermoregulation in two groups of animals kept under the same conditions.
entries.zh: 她的课题比较了处于相同条件下的两组动物的体温调节情况。

entries.en: Revell carried the empty frame home, planning to find a picture for it later.
entries.zh: 雷维尔把空画框带回家，打算以后再找一幅画装进去。

entries.en: Dury tried the soup before deciding whether it needed any more salt.
entries.zh: 杜里先尝了尝汤，再决定是否需要添盐。

entries.en: Bakker found a quiet seat where he could watch the children without joining their game.
entries.zh: 巴克找了个安静的座位，可以看着孩子们，又不用加入他们的游戏。

entries.en: Winkler had brought the wrong shoes, but he joined the walk anyway.
entries.zh: 温克勒带错了鞋，但还是参加了那次步行。

entries.en: Morgans closed the book when he heard someone trying the handle of the locked door.
entries.zh: 摩根听到有人试着拧那扇锁着的门的把手，便合上了书。

entries.en: I kept half of my bridie for the train journey home.
entries.zh: 我留了半个肉馅饼，准备回家乘火车时吃。

entries.en: Enright waited for the room to become quiet before telling us what had happened.
entries.zh: 恩赖特等房间里安静下来，才告诉我们发生了什么。

entries.en: Cairncross smiled at the portrait but asked why his shoes were missing from it.
entries.zh: 凯恩克罗斯看着肖像笑了，却又问为什么画里没有他的鞋。

entries.meaningZh: 罚打手心〔英国英语，旧式学校故事语境〕
entries.en: In the old school story, the headmaster threatens to pandy a boy for arriving late.
entries.zh: 在那个旧式学校故事里，校长威胁要因一名男生迟到而打他的手心。

entries.en: The technician removed the damaged spinneret before the next production run.
entries.zh: 技术员在下一轮生产开始前拆下了受损的喷丝头。

entries.en: The student marked the outline of a vastus on the anatomy sketch.
entries.zh: 那名学生在解剖草图上标出了股肌的轮廓。

entries.en: An enthusiastic Europhile, he argued that the exchange programme should be extended for another year.
entries.zh: 他是个热情的亲欧人士，主张将那个交流项目再延长一年。

entries.en: Bovey looked surprised when the child asked whether the painting had a story behind it.
entries.zh: 那个孩子问起画背后是否有故事时，博维显得很惊讶。

entries.en: Bianca chose a plain envelope because she did not want the letter to attract attention.
entries.zh: 比安卡选了一个朴素的信封，因为她不想让那封信引人注意。

entries.en: A bottle of chloral had been left outside the cabinet after the inventory.
entries.zh: 盘点后，一瓶三氯乙醛被留在了柜子外面。

entries.en: The child watched the zoetrope until the little paper horse seemed to run.
entries.zh: 那个孩子盯着旋转画筒看，直到纸上的小马仿佛跑了起来。

entries.en: A meticulous conserver of family papers, she had even kept the old envelopes.
entries.zh: 她一丝不苟地保存家族文书，连旧信封也留着。

entries.en: A patch of oil beneath the intercooler caught the mechanic's attention.
entries.zh: 中间冷却器下方的一摊油引起了机械师的注意。

entries.en: The nephrologist arrived early and helped the conference organiser arrange the chairs.
entries.zh: 那位肾病学家早早到了，帮会议组织者摆椅子。

entries.en: The Aragonese painter brought three unfinished portraits to the workshop.
entries.zh: 那位阿拉贡画家带了三幅尚未完成的肖像画来参加工作坊。

entries.en: During the attic cleanout, we found the missing lid inside an old suitcase.
entries.zh: 清理阁楼时，我们在一只旧行李箱里找到了不见了的盖子。

entries.en: Sommer remembered the shape of the house but could not draw it from memory.
entries.zh: 萨默记得那座房子的形状，却无法凭记忆把它画出来。

entries.en: Shelagh had been waiting for an apology, not another explanation of the problem.
entries.zh: 希拉一直等着的是一句道歉，而不是对问题的又一次解释。

entries.en: Perceval put his book aside and listened to the rain on the roof.
entries.zh: 珀西瓦尔把书放到一旁，听着屋顶上的雨声。

entries.en: The micromechanics seminar ended with a lively discussion of a cracked metal sample.
entries.zh: 那场微观力学研讨会以对一块开裂金属样品的热烈讨论结束。

entries.en: His paternal grandparents kept an old map of Mecklenburg in a drawer beneath the radio.
entries.zh: 他的祖父母在收音机下面的抽屉里放着一张梅克伦堡的旧地图。

entries.en: Manny carried the flowers carefully, hoping they would survive the crowded bus journey.
entries.zh: 曼尼小心地拿着花，希望它们经得住那趟拥挤的公交车程。

entries.en: Logue opened the parcel at the kitchen table while we watched from the doorway.
entries.zh: 洛格在厨房桌旁拆包裹，我们在门口看着。

entries.en: Mrs Laine asked whether anyone had seen a small red glove near the gate.
entries.zh: 莱恩夫人问是否有人在大门附近见过一只红色的小手套。

entries.en: Halpin had missed the introduction, so he was not sure who the speaker was.
entries.zh: 哈尔平错过了开场介绍，因此不确定主讲人是谁。

entries.en: Eriksson found the old keys behind the drawer rather than inside it.
entries.zh: 埃里克松是在抽屉后面找到那些旧钥匙的，而不是在抽屉里面。

entries.en: We played cassino until someone spilled a glass of water over the cards.
entries.zh: 我们一直玩卡西诺牌戏，直到有人把一杯水洒到了牌上。

entries.en: Bourget wrapped the frame in a blanket and asked us to carry it together.
entries.zh: 布尔热用毯子包住画框，请我们一起抬。
